en.t: The student came closer to the temple gate.

units.source_text: 他为了不让我家觉，绕向山门的东侧偷看了我一眼。

en.t: So that I would not notice him, he circled around to the east side of the temple gate and stole a glance at me.

units.source_text: 正值出外化缘的僧侣回寺庙的时刻。

en.t: It was just the time when the monks who had gone out begging for alms were returning to the temple.

units.source_text: 僧侣们脚用草鞋，三人一队成群地从东边的小径踏着石板路并排走过来。

en.t: The monks wore straw sandals and came walking side by side over the stone paving from the eastern path, grouped in teams of three.
They all carried their straw hats hanging from their hands.

units.source_text: 回到住处之前，他们都遵循化缘的规矩，只能将视线扫到眼前三四尺的地方，彼此不得交头接耳，静静地在我的面前走过，据向右边了。

en.t: Before returning to their quarters, they all followed the rules of alms begging, keeping their eyes lowered to only three or four feet ahead, not whispering to one another, and quietly passed in front of me before turning to the right.
